summary: Aegon Ltd., a Bermuda-incorporated Dutch-based life insurer, filed a Form 6-K furnishing amended and restated bye-laws adopted by shareholders on October 8, 2026, effective October 15, 2026, which restate the bye-laws adopted June 10, 2026. The excerpt covers governance mechanics including share capital, meetings, board powers, dividends, and amalgamation, with no transaction, stake, price, or premium disclosed. This is a routine foreign-issuer governance filing equivalent to a US 8-K exhibit, not a special situation; no board recommendation or advisor is named. No deal terms, no arbitrage angle.
